title: One event type handled by an app's consumer: its reader, command, handler and table

app.description: The service under apps/, generated with --consumer.

module.description: The feature directory under src/; its consumer module is created when absent.

name.description: The command the message becomes, a verb phrase: record-date-drafted.

topic.description: The topic it arrives on: arthome.catalog.date.

type.description: The type header it handles: catalog.date.drafted.v1.

schema.description: Its Protobuf schema exported by @arthome-platform/events: DateDraftedSchema.

key.description: The event's string field naming what the fact is about: dateId.

occurredAt.description: The event's Timestamp field the order guard compares.

table.description: The table keeping the last fact per key; <schema without Schema>_fact by default.
